# OpenZeppelin dependency provenance

Unmodified dependency sources from the npm package `@openzeppelin/contracts@5.0.2`. Only the transitive sources required by RobinhoodOrdinal are included. Preserve their SPDX MIT license notices. The package version is recorded in package.json.

Source: https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/tree/v5.0.2

Compiler target: Solidity 0.8.26 / Paris. This avoids MCOPY dependencies in later versions while using the 5.0.2 Base64 security fix.
